description: Build a valid robots.txt with allow and disallow rules, crawl-delay and a sitemap directive. Live preview, then copy or download the file.

faqs.a: It tells search engine crawlers which parts of your site they may or may not crawl. Place it at your domain root.
No — it is a request, not enforcement. Well-behaved crawlers obey it; malicious bots ignore it.
The number of seconds a crawler should wait between requests. Not all search engines honor it.

howto: Pick the default rule: allow everything or disallow everything.
Add extra disallow and allow paths, one per line.
Optionally set a user-agent, crawl-delay and your sitemap URL.
Watch the live preview, then copy or download robots.txt.
title: Robots.txt Generator
